secretScan.scope: versioned-like working tree files matching ts|tsx|js|cjs|mjs|json|yml|yaml|md|env; skips node_modules .git dist .next coverage docker/postgres-data; skips .env.example
secretScan.gitHistory: single foundation commit 6dc0a25; scanner walks files not pack objects. Residual: object-level history scan not executed.

highAdvisories.runtimeUse: Nest HTTP adapter; Foundation does not expose file-upload endpoints
highAdvisories.exploitability: DoS on multipart parsing IF an upload route is added and left unbounded. Not demonstrated as reachable on current Foundation routes (login JSON, heartbeat JSON).
highAdvisories.upgradeRisk: Major Nest 10 → 11; out of this gap-closure without explicit decision

highAdvisories.runtimeUse: Next/CSS build pipeline; not a direct user-upload CSS parser in Foundation UI
highAdvisories.exploitability: Advisories involve sourceMappingURL / stringify. Requires attacker-controlled CSS into PostCSS with `from` unset. Next build of first-party CSS is the current path — not treated as automatically exploitable in production request handling.

npmAudit.decision: No major upgrade in this round. High advisories recorded, not certified safe, not auto-approved.
